description: This file is a Perl script for parsing and managing kernel configuration files in the context of the Linux build system. It provides functions to load, compare, merge, and process configuration options, and appears to be a utility for handling config files, specifically those with variables prefixed by 'CONFIG_'.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets the configuration value for a specific key, considering the mod_plus flag.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration options from a file into a hash, parsing lines with a specific prefix and handling set/unset flags.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configuration hash references, keeping only keys with matching values.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes, with special handling based on the mod_plus flag.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Calculates differences between two configurations, optionally including only new entries.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line in the format CONFIG_name=value or as not set.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Outputs the entire configuration hash to standard output.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Recursively parses an expression for configuration combinations or load commands.
